player_prompt.intro:
Waxaad ugu wataan ciyaarta lambarada Countdown!
Waxa aad u baahan tahay: Isku darka lambarooyinka si aad u gaadho target-ka.
Foomka aad ugu sameysan waa: [i j op] halka i,j waa indeksoyo iyo op waa calaamadda.
Tusaale: [0 2 *] waa ugu daraya lambar 0 iyo lambar 2.
Dhajinta waa inay bixiso lambarooyin buuxa oo kaliya.

board.best: {observation} Ugu Fiican ilaa hadda: {best_value} (masaafada: {distance}) Muujinta ugu fiican: {best_expression}

invalid_move.wrong_format: Invalid action format. Use `[i j op]` where i,j are indices and op is +,-,*,/
invalid_move.invalid_indices: Tilmaamaha aan ansax ahayn waa inay kala duwan yihiin waana inay ku jiraan inta u dhaxaysa 0-{max_index}
invalid_move.invalid_operation: Hawlgal aan sax ahayn (qaybinta eber ama natiijo aan tiro dhan ahayn)

outcome.win: Waa hagaag! waxaa la helay bartilmaameed sax ah: {target}
outcome.no_moves: Wax kale oo dhaqaaq ah ma jiraan. Natiijadii ugu fiicnayd: {best_value} (bartilmaameed: {target})
outcome.turn_limit: Xadka wareegga ayaa la gaadhay. Natiijadii ugu fiicnayd: {best_value} (bartilmaameed: {target})
